description: Reuse an existing normalizer for a local behavior change without adding general machinery or a second implementation.

argv: import importlib; import normalization; import search; from unittest.mock import patch; assert search.find_labels([" A  B ", "other", "a b"], "a B") == [" A  B ", "a b"]; assert search.find_labels([], "x") == []; replacement=lambda text: text.replace("-", "").lower(); scope=patch.object(normalization, "normalize_label", side_effect=replacement); scope.start(); importlib.reload(search); assert search.find_labels(["A-B", "c"], "ab") == ["A-B"]; scope.stop()
